text: Sirkooɓe ɓen hino waɗana sanamuuji maɓɓe ɗi anndaa huunde ɗin -tawde ɗi sottataa, ɗi nafataa ɗi lorrataa- geɓal e jawle maɓɓe ɗe Men arsiki ɓe ɗen, ɓe ɓaɗtora ɗi ɗen. Wallaahi! Onon ɓee sirkooɓe, on lannditoyte Ñalnde Darngal, fii kon ko aaƴotonoɗon e wiide sanamuuji ɗin ko reweteeɗi, e wonnde hiɗi mari geɓal e jawle mon ɗen.
